attachment.download.scope: Authorization is by Confluence space. The page or blog locator resolves to its owning space; content and comment IDs are operation locators, not policy resource IDs or separate grant scopes.
attachment.download.attachments: Use the current content locator; draft attachments require the separate draft actions. Add, list and download are independently authorized; attachment delete is not exposed. Use a returned attachmentId; the provider proves attachment membership before releasing bounded raw bytes.
attachment.download.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence page attachment download [OPTIONS] --attachment-id <ATTACHMENT_ID> <PAGE_ID>; run agent-access confluence page attachment download --help for flags and input alternatives.

attachment.list.scope: Authorization is by Confluence space. The page or blog locator resolves to its owning space; content and comment IDs are operation locators, not policy resource IDs or separate grant scopes.

attachment.list.pagination: Pass returned nextPageToken unchanged as nextPageToken with the same target and effective maxResults. Tokens expire 15 minutes after issuance and every page is reauthorized. Stable signing-key configuration lets list tokens survive reload/restart while their bindings remain valid; runtime-key tokens do not. Rejecting a token requires restarting this listing without it; do not treat it as an upstream cursor.
attachment.list.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence page attachment list [OPTIONS] [PAGE_ID]; run agent-access confluence page attachment list --help for flags and input alternatives.

blog.create.scope: Authorization is by Confluence space. Use the supplied space key; content and comment IDs are operation locators, not policy resource IDs or separate grant scopes.

blog.create.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence blog create [OPTIONS] --space <SPACE> --title <TITLE> --content-format <CONTENT_FORMAT>; run agent-access confluence blog create --help for flags and input alternatives.

blog.draft.attachment.add.scope: Authorization is by Confluence space. The verified draft handle determines the content's space; content and comment IDs are operation locators, not policy resource IDs or separate grant scopes.
blog.draft.attachment.add.draftHandle: Supply the exact draftHandle returned for this content ID. It has no expiry and binds the tenant, execution context, content and credential method: static token kind, or OAuth connection and generation, plus the gateway cloud_id when that route is used. Routine OAuth refresh preserves the handle; reconnecting OAuth or changing its account invalidates it. Changing credential method, static token kind or gateway site also returns invalid_draft_handle. Replacing a static token value with the same kind and route preserves the binding. Per-user handles belong to that user; service-mode handles may be handed to another principal admitted in service mode under current policy. Every action still reauthorizes its space.
blog.draft.attachment.add.attachments: Only new-draft attachments are supported; staged draft attachments fail closed. Add, list and download are independently authorized; attachment delete is not exposed. Use the multipart upload contract; local file descriptors generate attachment metadata.

The exact action's contentFormat enum reflects effective configuration; required-content actions without an effective target are absent. Do not append a manual footer; configured attribution is applied in native form. Oversize source or final content returns body_size_denied/413; unsupported format returns body_format_unsupported/415. Source and converted bodies do not enter audit or diagnostics.
page.inline_comment.reply.add.readPresentation: When advertised, readContentFormat preserves the returned comment's native body and places renderedBody beside that body's owning comment. It is separate from write contentFormat and makes no extra provider call.
page.inline_comment.reply.add.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence page inline-comment reply [OPTIONS] --content-format <CONTENT_FORMAT> <COMMENT_ID>; run agent-access confluence page inline-comment reply --help for flags and input alternatives.

page.inline_comment.reply.list.scope: Authorization is by Confluence space. The comment's owning page or blog determines its space; content and comment IDs are operation locators, not policy resource IDs or separate grant scopes.
page.inline_comment.reply.list.presentation: bodyFormat selects the native comment representation. Non-native readContentFormat retains each native body and places renderedBody beside that body's owning comment. Whole-result Markdown and embedded formatting use only returned bodies and do not fetch more comments or pages.
page.inline_comment.reply.list.pagination: Pass returned nextPageToken unchanged as nextPageToken to the same comment action and target, keeping bodyFormat, filters and effective maxResults unchanged. Tokens expire after 15 minutes and every page is reauthorized. Stable-key list tokens can survive reload/restart with unchanged bindings; runtime-key tokens cannot. On rejection start a new listing without the token. Results carry comments, count, hasMore and nextPageToken; replies may include parentCommentId.
page.inline_comment.reply.list.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence page inline-comment replies [OPTIONS] <COMMENT_ID>; run agent-access confluence page inline-comment replies --help for flags and input alternatives.

page.inline_comment.update.scope: Authorization is by Confluence space. The comment's owning page or blog determines its space; content and comment IDs are operation locators, not policy resource IDs or separate grant scopes.
page.inline_comment.update.content: Supply both content and explicit contentFormat; format is never inferred. When advertised, storage, markdown and plain_text are strings; normalized formats become storage. atlas_doc_format is not accepted by this action. The exact action's contentFormat enum reflects effective configuration; required-content actions without an effective target are absent. This comment update does not append attribution; do not add a manual footer. Oversize source or final content returns body_size_denied/413; unsupported format returns body_format_unsupported/415. Source and converted bodies do not enter audit or diagnostics.
page.inline_comment.update.readPresentation: When advertised, readContentFormat preserves the returned comment's native body and places renderedBody beside that body's owning comment. It is separate from write contentFormat and makes no extra provider call.
page.inline_comment.update.version: Supply the current baseVersion. A mismatch returns version_conflict before mutation; an update sends baseVersion + 1.
page.inline_comment.update.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence page inline-comment update [OPTIONS] --base-version <BASE_VERSION> --content-format <CONTENT_FORMAT> <COMMENT_ID>; run agent-access confluence page inline-comment update --help for flags and input alternatives.

page.inline_comment.view.scope: Authorization is by Confluence space. The comment's owning page or blog determines its space; content and comment IDs are operation locators, not policy resource IDs or separate grant scopes.
page.inline_comment.view.presentation: bodyFormat selects the native comment representation. Non-native readContentFormat retains each native body and places renderedBody beside that body's owning comment. Whole-result Markdown and embedded formatting use only returned bodies and do not fetch more comments or pages.
page.inline_comment.view.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence page inline-comment view [OPTIONS] <COMMENT_ID>; run agent-access confluence page inline-comment view --help for flags and input alternatives.

page.move.placement: Give exactly one of pageId/url, position before/after/append, and exactly one of targetPageId/targetUrl. The source and target must be distinct current pages in one authorized space. append makes the target the parent and places the page last; before/after place it beside a sibling target with a page parent. The action verifies effective parent and direct-child ordering by readback. Parent clearing, cross-space moves and non-page targets are unsupported.

inputExamples.label: Append as the last child of the target page

page.move.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence page move [OPTIONS] --position <POSITION> [PAGE_ID]; run agent-access confluence page move --help for flags and input alternatives.

page.update.scope: Authorization is by Confluence space. The page or blog locator resolves to its owning space; content and comment IDs are operation locators, not policy resource IDs or separate grant scopes.
page.update.content: Supply both content and explicit contentFormat; format is never inferred. When advertised, atlas_doc_format is a JSON document object; storage, markdown and plain_text are strings. Normalized formats require the action's storage target. The exact action's contentFormat enum reflects effective configuration; required-content actions without an effective target are absent. Do not append a manual footer; configured attribution is applied in native form. Oversize source or final content returns body_size_denied/413; unsupported format returns body_format_unsupported/415. Source and converted bodies do not enter audit or diagnostics.
page.update.update: Supply baseVersion from the current content with content/contentFormat; title is optional. A stale version returns version_conflict. Successful readback must report baseVersion + 1. This action does not change page hierarchy; use page.move.
page.update.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence page update [OPTIONS] --base-version <BASE_VERSION> --content-format <CONTENT_FORMAT> <PAGE_ID>; run agent-access confluence page update --help for flags and input alternatives.

page.view.scope: Authorization is by Confluence space. The page or blog locator resolves to its owning space; content and comment IDs are operation locators, not policy resource IDs or separate grant scopes.
page.view.presentation: Returns current page metadata and configured native bodies. Non-native readContentFormat preserves the bodies and adds renderedBody beside root body. When both native representations are present, atlas_doc_format is selected before storage; malformed selected ADF fails instead of falling back. Whole-result Markdown uses only returned data.
page.view.resultMetadata: Created/updated actor and time fields are included when Confluence supplies them.
page.view.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence page view [OPTIONS] [PAGE_ID]; run agent-access confluence page view --help for flags and input alternatives.

search.pagination: Pass returned nextPageToken unchanged as nextPageToken to this action with the same query, spaces and effective maxResults. Tokens expire 15 minutes after issuance and a Broker reload or restart invalidates them. Every page is authorized again; a grant change that changes the composed query rejects continuation. On a rejected continuation, repeat the search without the token. The token also binds execution context, principal, credential mode/method and the service route.
search.results: Searches current pages only and returns metadata without bodies. Text mode matches titles; use CQL text ~ for full text. Created/updated actor and time metadata are returned when supplied. Whole-result formatting does not fetch bodies.
search.spaceKeys: Use exact space keys, including the tilde and case of personal keys such as ~alice. In CQL quote personal keys, for example space = "~alice". A personal-space grant does not imply ownership.
search.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence page search [OPTIONS]; run agent-access confluence page search --help for flags and input alternatives.

space.list.request: Omitting maxResults uses the configured maximum advertised by this action (50 in the default configuration, at most 100). Whole-result Markdown is supported. Keep actual space keys, including personal-space tilde and case; a personal-space grant does not imply ownership.
space.list.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence space list [OPTIONS]; run agent-access confluence space list --help for flags and input alternatives.

verify.scope: Authorization is by Confluence space. The page or blog locator resolves to its owning space; content and comment IDs are operation locators, not policy resource IDs or separate grant scopes.
verify.expectations: Give at least one of expectVersion, expectTitle or expectAttachmentId with the current-content locator. Read verification.status to distinguish matched from mismatch. Whole-result Markdown preserves the verification outcome and does not fetch body content.
verify.typedCommand: Typed CLI wrapper: agent-access confluence page verify [OPTIONS] <PAGE_ID>; run agent-access confluence page verify --help for flags and input alternatives.
